preconditions.description: T is the number of test cases (1 ≤ T ≤ 1e5), and each test case has N cities (1 ≤ N ≤ 1e5).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A_i <= 1e9 for A_i in [int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: Each city's significance A_i is a non-negative integer (0 ≤ A_i ≤ 1e9).

postconditions.description: For each test case, output the minimum total length of roads to connect all cities, or -1 if impossible. The result is computed by `compute_min_length(A)`, which returns the answer for a single test case.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result >= 0 and result <= sum(A) * max(A)) for result in [compute_min_length(A) for A in test_cases])
postconditions.description: The result is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum total length of roads (bounded by sum(A) * max(A)).

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result == 0 and all(A_i == 0 for A_i in A)) for result in [compute_min_length(A) for A in test_cases])
postconditions.description: If all cities have significance 0, the result is 0 (no roads needed).

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (result == sum(A) and all(A_i == A[0] for A_i in A)) for result in [compute_min_length(A) for A in test_cases])
postconditions.description: If all cities have the same significance A_i = A, the result is sum(A) (each road has length A).
